task_instance: Build a minimal Terraform Plugin Framework provider ("example") with an example_widget resource backed by an in-memory fake API client, then write and run terraform-plugin-testing acceptance tests following the skill's patterns: TestAccExample_basic (basic+update via ConfigStateChecks and a custom exists statecheck), an import test (both ImportStateVerify and ImportStateKind flows), a disappears test (custom disappears statecheck + ExpectNonEmptyPlan), a validation test (ExpectError), and a CheckDestroy TestCheckFunc.
evidence: Work in /tmp/claude-0/.../exec/hashicorp__agent-skills__provider-test-patterns/example. Installed Go module deps (terraform-plugin-framework v1.19.0, terraform-plugin-testing v1.16.0, terraform-plugin-go v0.31.0, terraform-json v0.28.0) and downloaded terraform CLI v1.9.8 binary to /usr/local/bin/terraform (no terraform preinstalled). Files written: api.go (FakeAPIClient/Widget in-memory backend + NotFoundError), provider.go (Plugin Framework provider, Protocol6), resource_widget.go (Create/Read/Update/Delete/ImportState for example_widget), validators.go (custom string-not-empty validator), resource_widget_test.go (provider factory testAccProtoV6ProviderFactories via providerserver.NewProtocol6WithError, config helpers with %[1]q verbs, custom statecheck.StateCheck implementations stateCheckExampleExists/stateCheckExampleDisappears, stateResourceAtAddress utility, testAccCheckExampleDestroy CheckDestroy func, and three test functions covering basic/update/import, disappears, and validation scenarios exactly per SKILL.md's Scenario Patterns section). `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` succeeded with no errors. Ran `TF_ACC=1 go test ./... -run TestAccExampleWidget -v -timeout 5m`: all three tests passed — TestAccExampleWidget_basic (3.91s, exercises plan/apply/refresh/final-plan lifecycle, ConfigStateChecks with ExpectKnownValue+NotNull, plus ImportStateVerify and ImportStateKind import steps), TestAccExampleWidget_disappears (0.93s, ExpectNonEmptyPlan after out-of-band delete), TestAccExampleWidget_validationError (0.74s, ExpectError regex match). Final: 'PASS / ok example.com/terraform-provider-example 5.591s'. This is a real, full run of the terraform-plugin-testing framework driving the actual terraform binary through plan/apply/destroy against an in-process provider server, verifying the skill's core deliverable (writing and running acceptance tests using its documented patterns) end-to-end without needing any real cloud credentials (the API layer is faked in-process, which is exactly the sanctioned test double per PreCheck/testAccAPIClient design in the skill).
